entities.summary: Wyatt Henry Johnston is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a centre for the Dallas Stars of the National Hockey League (NHL). Johnston was selected in the first round of the 2021 NHL entry draft by the Stars with the 23rd overall pick.
